name: EFC DOI coverage and consistency matrix
metric_note: in_atlas_literal_url measures only whether the DOI appears as a literal Figshare URL in the two atlas surfaces. Absence is not proof of absence of representation (bare numeric ids, references, or indirect links are not counted).
_note: Category counts are DOI-set counts: a DOI carrying N categories is counted in each, so empirical+methodological+structural may exceed unique_dois. That is multi-label overlap, recorded per row as category_overlap, not a contradiction. 'empirical' is the evidence register's own label, not a physics verdict: the atlas-scope rule (empirical -> atlas candidate) is a triage heuristic, and atlas_candidate rows require semantic node mapping.
